text:
1. 16. 4. 9. 

Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ. Atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ. Evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti. Atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti.
